changes: Replace the storefront background and still image with a neutral Los Angeles skyline.
Grow a Cavida emblem during the opening animation and reveal the asset branches as the intro ends.
Play a short muted FiveM aerial loop behind the storefront, with a still image when motion or video playback is unavailable.
Draw the active trunk and curved branches toward each asset in sequence when a category opens.
Align the branch paths to the desktop and mobile layouts and show them immediately with motion paused.
Group the Cavida showcase into an animated asset tree with category branches and a single active preview.
Browse the collection by category in bounded pages and search across the complete catalog.
Post commit subjects and grouped file changes in one Discord Changelogs message per branch push.
Announce newly published catalog products in Discord Releases with a direct product link.
Discord notifications use Components V2 with branded change, file, and release sections.
Source links and contributor identifiers are omitted from outgoing messages.
GitHub push and release embeds use English headings, labels, and summaries.
Ondertekende GitHub-pushes en gepubliceerde releases gaan naar afzonderlijke Discord-kanalen.
Pushmeldingen tonen commits en gewijzigde bestanden met de Cavida Store-naam en het Cavida-logo.
Bewegende Cavida-contourlijnen en licht zwevende assetpreviews.
Interactieve productkaarten, studioband, titelovergangen en Cavida-signatuur.
Gezamenlijke bewegingspauze met onthouden voorkeur en ondersteuning voor minder beweging.
Verlopen en afgeronde Tebex-winkelmanden worden zonder onterechte verbindingsfout opgeruimd.
Inloggen en toevoegen herstellen een verlopen winkelmandsessie.
Gerichte melding bij verlopen checkout; tijdelijke Tebex-storingen behouden actieve winkelmanden.
